summary: Practise EVM, variance analysis and project forecasting. Strengthen performance reporting with hands-on project control exercises. Explore the course.
lede: Project performance management helps project managers, project controls analysts and delivery leads compare actual progress, costs and forecasts with agreed plans. The course develops practical skills for turning project data into decisions, including defining useful indicators, linking scope, schedule and cost in an integrated baseline, interpreting earned value measures, forecasting completion and reporting variances with clear actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who track, analyse, govern or communicate project delivery performance and need to turn progress data into usable decisions.
modules: EAC and ETC Forecasting with EVM
prerequisites: Working familiarity with project delivery, project schedules or project budgets is useful. No coding or programming is required. Spreadsheet exercises use basic calculations and can be completed in Excel or an equivalent spreadsheet.
